label: VERIFIED
extraction: MCP Authorization (2025-06-18 spec): OAuth 2.1 for HTTP-based transports. Authorization OPTIONAL for MCP. HTTP transports SHOULD conform, STDIO SHOULD NOT (use env credentials), alternative transports MUST follow security best practices. Requirements: OAuth 2.1 with security measures for confidential/public clients, Dynamic Client Registration (RFC7591), Protected Resource Metadata (RFC9728), Authorization Server Metadata (RFC8414). Resource parameter (RFC8707) MUST be included in auth/token requests identifying MCP server. Short-lived access tokens, rotate refresh tokens for public clients. HTTPS required for all auth endpoints. PKCE mandatory. Token audience validation critical - servers MUST validate tokens issued for them. Token passthrough forbidden. Confused deputy prevention for proxy servers.
